title: Briefing for 2026-09-27
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-09-27: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: China saw 'surprise' jump in U.S. orders ahead of Trump-Xi summit, private survey shows. Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed. Global debt tops $365 trillion as economists sound alarm over 'vicious cycle'. Switzerland is keeping rates at 0% — for now. France's fresh budget battle threatens to topple another government. World heads into food crises 'blind' as U.S. aid cuts squeeze UN food agency, experts warn.
global: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days. Pope praises young people's 'energy and commitment' at huge open-air Mass in Paris. German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims. Republic of Ireland to wear black armbands for Israel game. Mother of woman found hanging in tree shocked as police say body was staged. Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared.
philippines: At long last, Mary Jane Veloso back home in Nueva Ecija. At Eurovision Asia, Carmelle steps onto her biggest stage yet. Record-breaking Albert Ian delos Santos earns Asian Games bronze. TikTok reaches first state settlement in US over teen safety claims, agrees to user limits.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
